title: Jae Lee
description: "STAR WARS is a great movie with great special effects and great spaceships and cool aliens,"' concludes Jae Lee. "l think it'll be a hit." Lee left scftool in Atlanta to become a monk, but somehow got sidetracked into comics. He did slave labor at Marvel for a couple of years, then went into indentured servitude at Image where "I'm whittling away my youth. With all the time I spend locked up in my room drawing, I might as well be a monk." Lee's past works include: MARVEL COMICS PRESENTS, UNCANNY X-MEN, X-EACTOR and NAMOR for Marvel; YOUNGBLOOD: STRIKEHLE and WILDC.A.T.S TRILOGY for Image. His own creation, HELLSHOCK, is upcoming from Image.
